historical_context: Designed by Danish architect Jørn Utzon, construction began in 1959 and was completed in 1973. It was designated a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2007.
verified_facts: The Sydney Opera House is a multi-venue performing arts centre in Sydney.
The structure is famous for its series of large precast concrete 'shells' covered in white Swedish ceramic tiles.
It was opened by Queen Elizabeth II on October 20, 1973.
